cohort: The study included 293 neonates, comprising 161 with sepsis and 132 controls.
finding: The combined PCT-CRP model significantly enhanced diagnostic performance for neonatal sepsis compared to either marker alone, achieving an AUC of 0.94.
mod_finding: Subgroup analysis confirmed consistent predictive performance across delivery mode.
gest_age: Neonates of varying gestational ages, including preterm infants.
